# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

At Nexura Security, the security of our users is our highest priority. We provide security updates for the latest major version of the plugin.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Nexura Security, please do **NOT** disclose it publicly or open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, please send an email to our security team at **security@nexurasecurity.com** or use the GitHub Security Advisory "Report a vulnerability" feature in this repository.

We take all security reports seriously and will respond as quickly as possible (usually within 24 hours) to verify the vulnerability and coordinate a fix. We will keep you updated on our progress and will credit you in our changelog once the vulnerability has been resolved and the update is released.

Thank you for helping us keep Nexura Security and its users safe!
